criteria: Documented neurological symptoms (e.g. headache with red flags, focal deficit, seizure)
Conservative treatment attempted for at least 4 weeks, OR red-flag symptoms present
Low back pain for at least 6 weeks with conservative therapy (PT, NSAIDs) attempted
OR progressive neurological deficit / suspected cauda equina
Imaging (MRI or X-ray) confirming meniscal tear or relevant pathology
Conservative management (PT, NSAIDs, activity modification) for at least 6 weeks with insufficient improvement
Confirmed diagnosis (e.g. Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, rheumatoid arthritis)
Inadequate response to at least one conventional therapy (e.g. corticosteroids, methotrexate)

policies.procedure_name: Office visit, established patient, low complexity
